name: Benchmarking_tpLMs_data
description: A Hugging Face dataset that collects evaluation data intended for benchmarking pretrained language models (tpLMs) across standard NLP tasks. It provides multiple task splits and examples for classification and generation-style evaluations to compare model behavior and performance. Evaluation typically includes both accuracy-style metrics and language-modeling metrics where applicable.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 for discriminative tasks and perplexity for language-modeling tasks
reputation: Small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited citation beyond repository usage.
